title: SQL Sheet
blurb: Twenty-five SQLite queries on the tables an ML engineer actually meets: experiment logs, eval results, inference requests, clickstreams and model registries. You start with single-table SELECTs and work up to window functions, recursive CTEs and sessionizing events, with every problem pinning down the NULL, tie and boundary cases that trip people up.
prereq: No SQL background is needed; it helps to know what a table, a row and a column are.
next: Take the same analyses into Python with the Pandas plan, then use them on model outputs in the Metrics & Evaluation problems.
